description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Vampire Charmseeker
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Vampire Charmseeker
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
